target.title: improve: speed up more test synchronization
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Several test paths used fixed sleeps or duplicate subprocess executions even when an observable completion signal was available. This made local and CI validation slower and left timing-sensitive tests with avoidable scheduling margins.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace fixed delays with response release hooks, validated PID/process-exit polling, and lock-queue diagnostics. The Matrix timeout-output assertion now exercises both streams in one subprocess while preserving the same behavior coverage.

## User Impact

No runtime behavior changes. Maintainers and contributors get faster, more deterministic Telegram transport, Matrix QA CLI, and PR gate tests.

AI-assisted: implemented and reviewed with Codex; the author understands the changes.

## Evidence

- Clean-base targeted shards: 21.67s; changed test-body time: 17.07s.
- Patched targeted shards: 19.84s; changed test-body time: 15.19s (1.88s / 11% faster).
- Telegram in-flight eviction test: 1.93s -> 1.15s.
- Matrix QA CLI file: 4.75s -> 3.96s; manual-kill case: 830ms -> 380ms.
- PR prepare gates file: 2.78s -> 2.37s.
- Latest-main Testbox focused proof: 47 tests passed across 3 shards; Actions run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29216587531.
- Latest-main `pnpm check:changed`: passed formatting, extension/test typechecks, lint, and tooling guards on the same Testbox lease.
- Fresh branch-mode autoreview: clean, no actionable findings.
